name: Qibla Finder
description: Find the exact qibla direction from your location in seconds using GPS and your phone compass — with distance to the Kaaba and accuracy tips.
longDescription: The qibla is the great-circle bearing from your coordinates to the Kaaba at 21.4225° N, 39.8262° E. instanten computes that bearing locally from your GPS position and points a live arrow at it, with a manual city fallback and a visible accuracy figure.
pricingDetails: Completely free. Location stays on your device.
features: Exact great-circle bearing to the Kaaba
Live dial that follows your rotation
useCases: Finding the qibla in a hotel room or unfamiliar city
Verifying a mosque's qibla wall direction
